review_notes: All2325B original and3879B organized bytes individually read; all16 complete named declarations, eight simp attributes and all recursive/evaluation proof terms inspected.

Negation/conjunction/disjunction encodings with their three proofs form one dependency-coherent seam. True/false constructions and their two proofs form an independent constant seam; XOR and its proof form another. Each retains exact expression arguments and arbitrary original Env.

All evaluation theorems are actual Bool equalities. The case splits, local hx/hy/h equations, simp term lists and proof order are unchanged. Eight original simp attributes remain attached. There is no theorem compiling arbitrary BoolExpr to NAND syntax and no general completeness/minimality/size/circuit claim.

Only same-source exact component modules are imported. Constant/XOR groups depend on the same-source gate module; all use the original historical Env provider through unchanged Folder.Boolean.Semantics import, with root path mismatch explicit.
